text:
maria_g: Heads-up — AcmeCorp escalated their SIG/CAIQ bespoke. Deadline Friday EOD. They want audit log proof for a KMS rotation, HSM attestation, and an explanation for an API 401 + suspected duplicate billing spike. @raj_cs @sam_sre can you take?

raj_cs: On it. What's the org-id and the exact window?

maria_g: org-acmepay, window 2026-03-15 14:00-14:10Z. They attached a repro saying they saw a 401 then retried which caused billing duplicates.

sam_sre: I pulled quick logs — saw auth failures around 14:02Z. Request ids: req_abc123, req_abc124. Starting full export.

eng-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T14:01:00Z completed on prod-gpu-1 (build bld-20260315-7).

tanya_sec: Customer explicitly asked for HSM vendor cert + KMS rotation proof and a CAIQ checkbox mapping for key lifecycle. We'll need to provide KMS event export and the attestation PDF.

sam_sre: Repro notes I'm assembling for CS:
1) Client calls POST /v1/generate with Authorization: Bearer <token>
2) Token hits expiry during request, server returns 401 auth_failed
3) Client retries the request without idempotency key, the retry completes and charges again

Logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:01Z] req_abc123 POST /v1/generate 401 auth_failed token_expired
[2026-03-15T14:02:02Z] req_abc123 RETRY POST /v1/generate 200 generation_ok latency=342ms
[2026-03-15T14:02:05Z] req_abc124 POST /v1/generate 200 generation_ok latency=290ms
```

raj_cs: Can SRE include kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt events and key rotation logs for org-acmepay? Need signed S3 link for the customer.

sam_sre: Starting audit export job including: access logs, admin actions, KMS request events, and key rotation metadata. Export job id export-1951023456-001.

maria_g: Also note — our default retention is 90 days but their bespoke SIG indicates 1 year. We need to offer an exported archive or retention exception. Legal will need to review.

tanya_sec: Legal pre-approve flow: we can provide an org-specific export into the customer's S3 bucket for up to 1 year retention on request, but must log a retention-exception ticket and attach cost estimate. I'll loop in legal.

raj_cs: ETA for the export link? I want to include the KMS attestation PDF and a short writeup mapping CAIQ questions to our artifacts.

sam_sre: Export will be ready in ~20m. I'll bundle: (1) audit_events_14-00_14-10.jsonl, (2) kms_events.csv, (3) key_rotation_manifest.json, (4) hsm_attestation_acme.pdf.

eng-bot: Audit export job started: export-1951023456-001 (status: running).

maria_g: For the customer reply: short summary + repro + remediation. Draft suggestion: "We observed a token expiry at 14:02Z causing a 401; the client retried and caused duplicate charges. We recommend adding idempotency keys and extending token grace window. We have attached KMS usage events and HSM attestation as requested." Keep it concise.

tanya_sec: Important: do NOT include any raw key material in the export. Only events, request IDs, and attestation docs.

sam_sre: Export completed. Signed link (expires in 7 days): https://s3.redwood-internal/export-1951023456-acme-log.zip

maria_g: Sending to AcmeCorp now and updating the bespoke SIG form. cc @legal-bot. :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Received export request; recorded ticket LEGAL-789. Reviewing retention exception and cost estimate.

raj_cs: I'll follow up with a short note in RT-3245 and propose a canary patch for a token-grace config if they want an immediate mitigation.

maria_g: Thanks everyone — closing this thread, continuing followups in RT-3245 and LEGAL-789.
